directionOutcome: target Beijing day close versus open, tie separate
timeOutcome: strict high or low pivot with two neighbors each side; target plus or minus 3 days
timeInputLatest: registration time only; Gann uses last 90 completed Beijing days
monthBoundary: exclude day with interior Jie transition from directional statistics
confluence: same date cooccurrence; opposing Bazi directions flagged as conflict; timing has no direction
directionControl: all scored eligible days, both up and down base rates
timeControl: all dates with complete plus or minus 5 day neighborhood on same observed period
missingData: missing bars and unknown calendar are unscored, never counted as failures
autoRefresh: while localhost server runs, after 00:20 Beijing; retry hourly if latest complete day is missing
